name: agentic-course-redesign
description: A gated, lecturer-in-the-loop workflow that adapts evidence-grounded redesign to the supplied course and processing environment.

interface.longDescription: Use one full-workflow umbrella entry for course material across subjects, educational levels, programmes, languages, assessment contexts, and delivery modes. A pre-source Gate 0A establishes material authority, sensitivity, student-data and protected-assessment handling, and exact-environment processing eligibility before any course path or source is requested or accessed. The workflow then adapts bounded specialist analysis, research, redesign, production, and QA to the lecturer-confirmed course. After final acceptance and an explicit requested/declined system-review response, the course run becomes complete and dormant; future manual or optional scheduled triggers always create a fresh run. No automation is registered or triggered by the plugin itself.
defaultPrompt: Check processing eligibility, then set up a protected redesign project for one course.
Audit an eligible, approved course for evidence-based redesign priorities.
Continue the active course-redesign run at its next approved gate.
